import os
import pathlib
import json
import tempfile

f = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".jsonl", delete=False)
log_path = f.name
f.close()

os.environ["HOOK_LOG"] = log_path

from checkpoint import PolicyHook
from domain.tokens import issue_user_token


class FakeEvent:
    def __init__(self, name, inp):
        self.tool_use = {"name": name, "input": inp}
        self.selected_tool = None
        self.cancel_tool = None


hook = PolicyHook(
    agent_name="expense-assistant",
    user="alice",
    base_url="http://localhost:8000",
    run_id="run-001",
    config_dir=pathlib.Path("config/agents"),
    bearer_token="",
)

e2 = FakeEvent("pay_vendor", {})
hook._before_tool_call(e2)
entry2 = json.loads(open(log_path).readlines()[-1])
assert entry2["decision"] == "deny", f"Expected deny, got {entry2['decision']}"
assert entry2["rule"] == "P7", f"Expected P7, got {entry2['rule']}"
assert e2.cancel_tool, "cancel_tool should be set"
print("Scenario 2 (deny P7 - tool not allowed): PASS")

e3 = FakeEvent("submit_expense", {"claimant": "alice", "amount": 50})
hook._before_tool_call(e3)
entry3 = json.loads(open(log_path).readlines()[-1])
assert entry3["decision"] == "deny", f"Expected deny, got {entry3['decision']}"
assert entry3["rule"] == "SCOPE", f"Expected SCOPE, got {entry3['rule']}"
assert e3.cancel_tool, "cancel_tool should be set"
print("Scenario 3 (deny SCOPE - missing token): PASS")

token = issue_user_token("alice", "mcp-server", ["expenses:submit"])
hook2 = PolicyHook(
    agent_name="expense-assistant",
    user="alice",
    base_url="http://localhost:8000",
    run_id="run-001",
    config_dir=pathlib.Path("config/agents"),
    bearer_token=token,
)

e4 = FakeEvent("submit_expense", {"claimant": "bob", "amount": 50})
hook2._before_tool_call(e4)
entry4 = json.loads(open(log_path).readlines()[-1])
assert entry4["decision"] == "deny", f"Expected deny, got {entry4['decision']}"
assert entry4["rule"] == "P1", f"Expected P1, got {entry4['rule']}"
assert e4.cancel_tool, "cancel_tool should be set"
print("Scenario 4 (deny P1 - claimant mismatch): PASS")

all_entries = [json.loads(line) for line in open(log_path).readlines() if line.strip()]
required_fields = {"call_id", "run_id", "timestamp", "sim_time", "user", "agent", "tool", "arguments", "decision", "rule", "reason"}
for entry in all_entries:
    missing = required_fields - set(entry.keys())
    assert not missing, f"Missing fields: {missing}"
print("All log entries have all 11 required fields: PASS")

print("\nAll quickstart validation scenarios PASSED")
